review.root: Full source reviews cover canonical batch publication, all Muse changes and original plus corrected native allocation attachment. Independently reproduced the combined join from archived bases/inputs; source/full manifests, patches, package/test/doc ledgers and provenance exactly match. Thirty-three sources are exact immutable after-files. Cross-source actual types propagate new ordinal/binding/owner representation sizes into original control facts; native attachment remains a separate original-proposal obligation. Four ordered docs preserve original additions then exact correction replacements. No native managed gateway or complete current-inventory support is enabled by this join. Central apply must preserve the test-only68 generic-error correction before appending the new publication test child. Central compilation corrected fixed_get_mut trait method resolution: candidate is &mut RegistryKey<K>, so an explicit RegistryKey<K> Borrow<K> call reborrows the key. This invokes the same existing key borrow and comparison once before mutation; lookup and locator-only commit semantics are unchanged. Fresh native CMake patching exposed missing standard Git file boundaries: its existing --recount consumed the next raw --- header as part of the prior hunk. Added per-file diff --git headers and the new-file mode for allocation_owners.h. Private replay proved original ordinary git apply and corrected --recount apply produce byte-identical five native source files. Native code and common idempotent patch policy are unchanged. Native Rust compilation enforced safemlx missing_docs on eleven new public methods/variants. Added precise representation, failure and owner-retention documentation; no executable code, error variant, safety boundary or visibility changed.

behavior: One canonical namespace preserves ordinary logarithmic lookup and preallocated bounded batches. Integer-locator commit performs no key/provider callback after mutation begins.

The original same-key C namespace and finite per-span S publication sum are sealed once. Real original contexts issue attempts; failed or panicking publication retains keys, prefixes and original custody without retry or refill.
Whole-batch capacity, duplicate, scope, source, stamp, origin-health and residual checks precede canonical insertion. Host-held original controls cannot fund new physical storage.

Muse actual group-1 text paths forward through the generic prepared composite architecture. Nonzero dense/routed, tied/untied and fixed rotary fixtures compare all real hooks, complete KV state and cached decodes.

One native FIFO allocation-owner list handles legacy and prepared nodes, shared Array/Host physical identity and existing aliases. The prepared successful handoff allocates no node and performs no completion housekeeping.
Cold preparation initializes the native error handler. The bounded initialized entry retains exact native errors without a lazy Once path.
Exact native deletion and Rust System deallocation witnesses verify backing/node retirement before accounting-owner drop through pending, rejected, unwound and attached cases.
limits: The publication registry and attachment primitive are verified independently of a completed original native multi-chunk composition; no managed facade gate is opened.
Same-session binding, current opening and completed inventories, enclosing input/output/graph/recovery resources and paged/partition acquisitions remain required composition work.
Prepared attachment layout prices concrete node/control representations, not arbitrary reachable payload, dynamic native exception storage, allocator overhead or total process memory.
No new released-checkpoint or native multirank execution was performed in this increment.
